construction: One closed loft between rounded vertical cross-sections. The skin remains connected between fold ridges. Separate broad top and bottom boards follow the envelope edges; seam piping follows the four observed ridge paths.

folds.form: Rounded shallow bulges with continuous concave valleys, not separate intersecting volumes
folds.amplitudeTaper: Decrease toward rigid throat to avoid leather intersecting its collar

boards.relationship: Follow upper and lower envelope boundaries and end inside throat collar

depthAuthority: Widths are inferred from frame separation and must be tested in an oblique view; they are not measurements recovered from the image.
